title: Computer dives
intro: Import a file into this diver’s personal computer history.
formats: Garmin dive FIT (one Descent/Connect export verified), UDDF, Subsurface XML, labeled CSV and ZIPs containing these files.
keepZone: Keep the source timezone or mark it unknown
confirmTarget: I confirm the selected dives belong to
error: Couldn’t complete this action. Check your files and access, then try again.
limit: Up to 5 files, 2 MB each. Original files are not saved.
previewOnly: Nothing is saved until you confirm the selected dives.
fileError: This file could not be read.
offsetHint: Use a fixed offset only when you know it. During daylight saving changes, verify which offset applied.
selectionHint: Exact duplicates stay in history; possible duplicates require your review.

warningCodes.timezone_unknown: Timezone unknown; the local clock is preserved.
warningCodes.profile_absent: This record has no depth profile.
warningCodes.multiple_recordings: This dive has multiple computer recordings.
warningCodes.local_time_unknown: Original local clock and timezone unknown; the recorded UTC instant is preserved.
warningCodes.duration_elapsed: Elapsed session duration can include surface time.
warningCodes.unmapped_fit_fields: Additional FIT telemetry is not imported. Keep the original file.
warningCodes.date_only: Only the date is known; time and timezone are unknown.

fileErrorCodes.unsupported_fit: This FIT activity or recording structure is not supported.
fileErrorCodes.unsafe_xml: XML declarations or entities are not accepted.
fileErrorCodes.limit_exceeded: The file exceeds the import limits.
fileErrorCodes.invalid_reference: The file contains an unresolved reference.
fileErrorCodes.invalid_csv: Check the CSV headers, mapped columns and date values.
fileErrorCodes.invalid_options: Check the selected CSV columns, date format and units.
fileErrorCodes.invalid_zip: This ZIP could not be read or contains no dive files.
fileErrorCodes.unsafe_zip: This ZIP contains an unsafe path or unsupported entry. Extract only the dive files and select them directly.
fileErrorCodes.zip_limit_exceeded: The ZIP exceeds the import limits. Select fewer extracted dive files.
fileErrorCodes.no_dives: No dives found in this file.

zipHint: Choose a ZIP, or extract it and choose the dive files. Images and document attachments are ignored; review the dives before importing.
betaHint: Vendor compatibility is beta except for the stated Garmin export. Review every preview. This choice records the source you provide; it does not connect your account.
exportCsvHint: CSV includes summaries and annotations. JSON also preserves profiles and gas details.
mappingHint: Choose a loose CSV file. Columns come from the first selected CSV; generic CSV files share this mapping. The labeled DiveDay template keeps its own units. Empty cells stay unknown.
mappingError: Couldn’t read CSV headers. Choose a CSV with unique column names.
mappingRequired: Choose the date, its format, and units for mapped fields. Use a different column for each field.
mappingOffsetHint: UTC offset: Z, +HH:MM, -HH:MM or unknown. With no column, the timezone stays unknown.
mappingDateHint: The date can include a time. A date without a time stays that way.

generic.label: Other file or spreadsheet
generic.hint: Use a supported dive file, the labeled template, or explicitly map your spreadsheet CSV.

oceanic.label: Oceanic+
oceanic.hint: Oceanic+ documents UDDF download. Import the UDDF or its ZIP here; a real Oceanic+ export has not been verified.

padi.label: PADI · manual CSV transfer
padi.hint: Beta manual CSV transfer. Copy your own entries into the template, or map a spreadsheet you already have. PADI’s native export format and a public integration are unverified.

ssi.label: SSI · manual CSV transfer
ssi.hint: Beta manual CSV transfer. Copy your own entries into the template, or map a spreadsheet you already have. SSI’s native export format and a general public integration are unverified.

garmin.label: Garmin
garmin.hint: One Descent/Connect single-session dive FIT export is verified. Other devices, sessions and export variants are beta.

shearwater.label: Shearwater Cloud
shearwater.hint: Shearwater Cloud documents UDDF/XML export. Real Shearwater exports are unverified; review the detected format and every dive.

subsurface.label: Subsurface
subsurface.hint: Subsurface documents XML/UDDF export. Only synthetic XML/UDDF fixtures are verified here.

suunto.label: Suunto
suunto.hint: Suunto documents FIT export. Suunto’s dive FIT variant is unverified here and may not import.
